report.objective: Persist the requested budget ceiling on the orchestrator's state record so GOV.ORCH.13 DL-3's budget column can be filled, and say plainly in the ledger when the provider that ran the movement cannot prove exhaustion against that ceiling. requirements: English, per AGENTS.md engineering-output language law.
Every changed function names the clause it implements (GOV.ORCH.13 DL-n).
Run only the test files named plus your own additions and the privacy gate.
Mechanical mismatches between this packet and the code are settled against the code and named in the SESSION_CLOSE; a RELAY_QUESTION is only for a decision in conflict.

risks: Back-filling the default ceiling onto old records to make the column look complete, which would invent a fact the record never held.
Marking an over-ceiling row in a way that a re-render then treats as a human assessment cell and preserves wrongly.
Changing the record's key set in a way an existing reader of that record does not expect; the run payload at the third site is read by scripts/dispatch_ledger.py and by orchestrator status.

in: scripts/orchestrator.py: write the requested ceiling onto the state record at all three sites named in what_exists, under the key max_budget_usd, beside the model_requested/effort_requested pair that is already there. Write the value that was actually requested for that dispatch; when none was given, write the module default rather than null, because the default is what the run was actually held to.
